query: UPDATE ops.jobs SET status=CASE WHEN $4 THEN 'QUEUED'::ops.job_status ELSE 'DEAD_LETTER'::ops.job_status END, run_after=CASE WHEN $4 THEN clock_timestamp()+make_interval(secs=>$5) ELSE run_after END, completed_at=CASE WHEN $4 THEN NULL ELSE clock_timestamp() END, lease_owner=NULL,lease_token=NULL,lease_expires_at=NULL, last_error_code=$6,last_error_detail=$7,version=version+1 WHERE id=$1 AND status='RUNNING' AND lease_token=$2 AND fencing_token=$3 RETURNING version
